Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5305021. Join molecule_dictionary through compound_records on molregno, filter by doc_id matching CHEMBL5305021, and require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles, sorted by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
